query.commandtext: SELECT ??,L.LOT_SEQ,W.WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W WHERE TEST_AREA = 'MULTIPROBE' AND L.END_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:stime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(:etime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.PROBE_CNT = 0 ??

SELECT L.LOT_SEQ, LOT_ID LOT, LOT_TYPE, FABLOT, TEST_AREA, NULL TEST_TYPE, NULL LOGPOINT, OPERATION, W.PROGRAM, DEVICE, SMS_DEVICE, DEVICE_ALIAS, SMS_ITEM_ID, FAMILY, W.FACTORY FACILITY, W.FACTORY SRCFAB, TO_CHAR(L.START_TIME,'YYMMDDHH24MI') AS LSTIME, TO_CHAR(L.END_TIME,'YYMMDDHH24MI') AS LETIME, WAFER_DIAM, L.COMMENTS, L.MERGE_FLAG, WAFER_SEQ, WAFER_ID, PROBE_CNT, TO_CHAR(W.START_TIME,'YYMMDDHH24MI') AS WSTIME, TO_CHAR(W.END_TIME,'YYMMDDHH24MI') AS WETIME, TO_CHAR(W.LOAD_TIME,'YYMMDDHH24MI') AS WLTIME, TESTER, PROBER, PROBE_CARD, HANDLER_ID, OPERATOR, START_QTY, PARENT, FLAGS, SCREEN_FLAG, SCRAP_FLAG, DGRADE_FLAG, VENDOR_ID, LOADBD, HOSTNAME, TESTHEAD, SW_REV, USP_REV, NVL(MAX_X,0) MAXX, NVL(MAX_Y,0) MAXY, WAF_FLAT, W.COMMENTS, NULL PLD_SEQ, NULL PPD_SEQ, SCRIBE_LOT, TEMP, TEMP_TYPE, NULL TESTER_TYPE, PGMPATH, SPC_FLAG, SPC_RULE, DATA_SOURCE, LOT_MODE, IMMED_REPROBE, DELAYED_REPROBE, TRUNCATION, NVL((SELECT ORIGIN_INDEX_X FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE MAPID = L.DEVICE_ALIAS),0) REF_DIEX, NVL((SELECT ORIGIN_INDEX_Y FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE MAPID = L.DEVICE_ALIAS),0) REF_DIEY, NULL PDM_SEQ, T7SCRIBE, M12SCRIBE, W.MERGE_FLAG, TWFLAGS, TFVERSION, ESDA_ID, WAF_DIAM_MEAS, XREF_VECTOR_MEAS, YREF_VECTOR_MEAS, SETUP_TIMESIZE, LOTDEF_DATABASE, MAXSITE, AC_RULE_SEQ, PROBECARD_TOUCHDOWNS, STEPSIZE_X, STEPSIZE_Y, BURNIN_TYPE, PROGRAM_MODE, LOTCONTROL_MODE, LC_FLAGS, AC_FLAGS, SMSFAMILY_NAME, LOT_CLOSE, SPC_ENABLE, SPC_STATUS, SCREEN_TYPE, NUM_DIE, TW_VALID_DATA_CNT, DATATYPE_FLAG, FORCE_SPCFAIL, LOTINFO_SEQ, AC_DIE_CNT, MOD_TIME FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W WHERE W.WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ
SELECT PROGRAM,LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT WHERE TEST_AREA='MULTIPROBE' AND DEVICE = :device AND LOT_ID =:lot ORDER BY 1
SELECT WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND PROBE_CNT = :probe_cnt
SELECT DISTINCT PROGRAM FROM TQP_LOT WHERE TEST_AREA = :test_area ?? ORDER BY 1
SELECT LOT_ID LOT,LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT WHERE TEST_AREA = :test_area AND PROGRAM = :program ?? ORDER BY 1 DESC
SELECT DISTINCT WAFER_ID,WAFER_SEQ FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = ( SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT WHERE TEST_AREA = :test_area AND PROGRAM = :program AND LOT_ID = :lot ) ?? AND PROBE_CNT = 0 ORDER BY 1
UPDATE TQP_MAPDEF SET USER_REF_X = :USER_REF_X, USER_REF_Y = :USER_REF_Y WHERE MAPID = :MAPID
